doctrine: Build an AI SaaS lead magnet using Claude Code + n8n-MCP in ~20 minutes: (1) Set up n8n-MCP by configuring .mcp.json with n8n API credentials (URL + API key); (2) Install n8n Skills for Claude via plugin marketplace or manual upload to enable workflow generation; (3) Use Claude Code with single prompt to generate full n8n workflow: webhook trigger → OpenAI LLM → Gmail notification → Google Sheets logging → JSON response. Core operations: search_templates (2,352 available) BEFORE building from scratch; validate_node(mode='minimal') → validate_node(mode='full') → validate_workflow in sequence; NEVER trust parameter defaults; batch operations with n8n_update_partial_workflow; branch parameter REQUIRED for IF node routing (true/false outputs). Front-end generation: Claude Code shifts to planning mode, generates Next.js/React landing page with form capture, auto-starts local server. Critical non-technical requirements: privacy policy, data processing agreements, user rights, cookie policy, security review before global launch. Document includes full workflow walkthrough: testing with mock data, debugging email/webhook integration issues, iterating on OpenAI prompt quality, fixing data path mappings in Google Sheets. Key limitation: Claude optimizes 12-step workflows better than 20+ step complex flows; hybrid human-machine approach needed for production. Delivery time achievable: 20 minutes for simple lead magnet, longer for complex multi-step automation.
